mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a User to hold both Officer and Auditor roles simultaneously, which violates FR-002 (the roles must be mutually exclusive for bank staff). The assertion checks that no user holds both roles; without the fact, Alloy can construct a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMultiplicityViolation { some u: User | Officer in u.roles and Auditor in u.roles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two applications from the same applicant to both be in Pending or UnderReview status simultaneously, violating FR-008 (one in-flight per applicant). The assertion enforces the mutex.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlightViolation { some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication | app1.applicant = app2.applicant and (app1.status = Pending or app1.status = UnderReview) and (app2.status = Pending or app2.status = UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an assigned officer to be the same as the applicant, violating FR-010 and FR-011 (no self-assignment). The assertion checks assigned_officer != applicant; without the fact, Alloy can construct a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignmentViolation { some app: LoanApplication | app.assigned_officer = app.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two audit entries for the same application to have identical timestamps, violating append-only semantics (FR-018). Without the fact, Alloy can construct two entries with the same timestamp, violating the assertion that timestamps are unique per application.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditNotAppendOnly { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.timestamp = ae2.timestamp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an application where applicant == assigned_officer to have a non-Pending status, violating FR-013 (no self-approval). The assertion enforces that self-assigned apps remain at Pending; without the fact, Alloy can construct a counterexample where such an app is in UnderReview or Approved.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfApprovalViolation { some app: LoanApplication | app.applicant = app.assigned_officer and (app.status = UnderReview or app.status = Approved or app.status = Rejected) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries with invalid status transitions (e.g., Approved → UnderReview or Pending → Approved), violating FR-009 (only pending→under_review→{approved,rejected} allowed). The assertion checks only valid transitions; without the fact, Alloy can construct illegal ones.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidTransition { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.prev_status = Approved and ae.new_status = Pending) or (ae.prev_status = Pending and ae.new_status = Approved) }
